text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Vikram Nair –   5 To ask the Acting Minister for Transport (a) whether the steady increase in Private Hire Car Driver's Vocational Licence is a sustainable trend; and (b) whether there are plans to manage the number of private hire car drivers.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: I apologise, Mr Speaker, the question is Question No 5, which is on whether or not there is a steady increase in the vocational licences, whether there is a sustainable trend and whether there are plans to manage the number of private hire car (PHC) drivers.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: It is important for us to have PHCs continue to be an important mode of transport in our transport system, largely because they provide for people who are unable to drive or are unwilling to own a car but yet would like to have access to private transport on a pay-per-use basis.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: And I think we want to be able to continue to do that.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: I think generally leaving the numbers to the free market is not objectionable.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: The only caveat is that in the case of PHC drivers, people may be giving up opportunities to engage in other professions in order to have the freedom of being a PHC driver.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: And if the numbers were to go up too much, they may not be able to earn a livelihood.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: I suggest there might be some basis to intervene in the market, if the numbers appear too large, or PHC drivers' incomes and all that keep going down.

speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
text: I agree with the hon Member that indeed there are alternative occupations that, particularly this group who are Singaporean, can potentially take in the economy.

speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
text: But this group of PHC drivers, it is a diverse group.

speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
text: There are professional drivers who are doing the same thing as taxi drivers, driving full-time.
